judging_guidance: There is no mandatory winning component. A RapidParse-plus-translator proposal can succeed if its whole-system uncertainty and a decisive comparative test are explicit. A CarefulParse proposal is not automatically correct: group scaling and blurred-image handling remain unproven. Evaluate the architecture argument and experiment, not component names.

criteria.description: Uses complete batch visibility, linkage and duplicate behavior as acceptance; does not replace the outcome with parser latency.

Compares complete configurations and their interfaces, accounting for the serial upload bottleneck, translator uncertainty and native group path; reasons with the provided scope and arithmetic without assuming linear scale is proof.
Makes a justified conditional choice or a bounded comparison experiment and identifies unresolved blurred-image handling.
Prioritizes an end-to-end mixed 500-item staging experiment with retries and visibility checks; distinguishes sample probes and estimates from acceptance evidence.

critical_failures.description: Declares the fastest parser the winning or verified solution solely from parser latency while disregarding the known batch/upload outcome.
Claims the five-minute whole-batch target, correct linkage or duplicate behavior was measured for 500 receipts when only the supplied probes exist.
